title: WPMS/264/2003 of CHETAN KAPOOR Vs ADDL. D.J and ORS

paras.text:
Hon. M.M. Ghildiyal J.
Heard Sri D.C.S. Rawat
learned counsel for the applicant
and Sri V.K. Bisht learned counsel
for the respondents.
The court while passing the
order dated 09.04.2003 in writ
petition no. 264 (M/S) 2003 has
granted six months time to the
applicant to vacate the
accommodation in dispute and the
petitioner has given undertaking to
this effect before the prescribed
authority. The petitioner applicant
moved modification application
9646 of 2003 on which the court
granted one moth further time to
vacate the accommodation in
dispute.
The present modification
application has been moved by the
petitioner for grant of six months
time to vacate the accommodation
in dispute. The conduct of the
petitioner is not fair. The
modification application is
dismissed.
(M.M.Ghildiyal, J.)
20.11.2003
MPS
